blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
AI agents increasingly carry out long-horizon professional work, but their evaluations rarely require a finished creative deliverable.
To this end, we introduce Timeline-Bench , a benchmark of 56 real video-editing tasks, each asking an agent to turn raw production material into a finished video.
Tasks range from selecting dialog takes and shaping interview footage into a story to cutting commercials from product shots, voiceovers and graphics.
Every task provides a brief, source assets, a container and a set of tests.
A task is resolved when the output passes every test.
The tests check the delivery format, the content and the brief’s explicit requirements, and include a quality test calibrated on 2,582 blind judgments by 43 video editors.
We evaluate 16 agents that pair frontier models with coding-agent harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode.
The best, GPT-6 Astra in Codex with curated editorial guidance, resolves only 15 of the 56 tasks (26.8%), and the average agent resolves 14.0%.
Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of judgments.
Most unresolved runs (562 of 771) fail only the quality test: agents perceive footage through stills and transcripts and check their renders for defects, not craft.
We release the tasks, verifier and per-run results at https://timelinebench.tensortest.com .
blocks.zh:
AI代理越来越多地开展长视野的专业工作,但是他们的评价很少需要完成的创造性交付.
为此,我们引入了Timeline-Bench, 以56个真实的视频编辑任务为基准, 各请一名代理商将原始制作材料变成完成的视频.
任务范围从选择对话框到将访谈录像制作成故事,到从产品镜头、语音和图形中剪切广告。
每一项任务都提供简要的,源资产,一个容器和一套测试.
每次测试都会通过一个任务。
测试检查投递格式、内容和简报的明确要求,并包括由43名视频编辑对2 582项盲判进行质量测试。
我们评估了16名特工 将前沿模型 与编码代理 诸如Codex, Claude Code 和OpenCode 等
最佳的GPT-6 Astra在Codex中带有曲解的编辑指导,只解决了56项任务中的15项(26.8%),平均代理解决率为14.0%.
人类编辑更喜欢在83.5%的判决中进行参考编辑.
大多数未解决的运行(771次中的562次)仅未能通过质量测试:特工通过静物和记录誊本看到镜头,并检查其成份是否有缺陷,而不是手工业。
在https://timelinebench.tensortest.com发布任务、核查结果和每个运行结果。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent frontier models have substantially advanced the ability of AI agents to perform software engineering, scientific computing, and professional knowledge work ( OpenAI, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026b ) . Models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 combine stronger reasoning with improved computer use and sustained problem solving, enabling agents to carry out complex workflows across software applications. Systems such as Codex and Claude Code provide the tools to execute code, inspect intermediate results, and iteratively refine their work ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026a ) . These capabilities also extend to creative applications: for example, OpenAI demonstrates Astra modeling a house in Blender and turning it into an interactive scene in Unreal Engine ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . As agents take on a wider range of professional work, benchmarks must assess their ability to complete realistic workflows and produce useful deliverables. Evaluations such as GDPval, Agents’ Last Exam, and AutomationBench reflect this growing emphasis ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Shepard & Salimans, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的前沿模型大大提高了AI代理人员从事软件工程,科学计算和专业知识工作的能力(OpenAI, 2026a;Anthropic, 2026b ). GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1等模型将更强推理与改进计算机使用和持续解决问题结合起来,使代理能够跨软件应用进行复杂的工作流程. Codex和Claude Code等系统提供了执行代码,检查中间结果,并迭代完善其工作的工具(OpenAI,2025;Anthropic,2026a ). 这些能力也扩展到了创造性的应用:例如,OpenAI演示了Astra在Blender建模一栋房子,并将其变成非真实引擎的互动场景(OpenAI,2026a). 随着工作人员开展更广泛的专业工作,基准必须评估他们完成现实工作流程和产生有用成果的能力。 GDPval, Agents ' Last Exampion,以及Automation Bench等评价反映了这种日益强调(Patwardhan等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Shepard & Salimans,2026年)。

blocks.en: Video editing presents a demanding environment for such an evaluation. Used in filmmaking, advertising, education, and digital media, it requires interpreting a brief, understanding source footage, and coordinating picture, speech, music, and graphics over time. These decisions are interdependent: changing a shot can alter the meaning of the accompanying narration, while changing its duration can affect pacing and synchronization. Although broad professional benchmarks include media-related tasks ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , their aggregate results provide limited insight into these editorial capabilities. A focused evaluation is therefore needed to assess whether agents can turn raw audiovisual material and a brief into a coherent finished video.
blocks.zh: 视频编辑为这种评价提供了一个要求很高的环境。 它用于电影制作、广告、教育和数字媒体,需要解释一个简短的、理解源的镜头,并随着时间的推移协调图片、言论、音乐和图形。 这些决定是相互依存的:改变一个镜头可以改变伴随的叙述的意义,而改变其持续时间可以影响速度和同步. 虽然广泛的专业基准包括了与媒体有关的任务(Patwardhan等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年),但其总体结果对这些编辑能力提供了有限的见解. 因此,需要开展重点评估,以评估代理商是否能够将原始视听材料和简报转化为连贯的成品录像。

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce Timeline-Bench , a benchmark for evaluating agents on complete video-editing assignments, from raw production material to finished video. Timeline-Bench assesses whether agents can carry out workflows encountered in filmmaking, documentary production, advertising, and digital media, including constructing a narrative from interviews, assembling scenes from multiple takes, and producing promotional videos from mixed audiovisual assets. Each task in the benchmark is defined by a collection of source material, a project-specific brief, and a reproducible execution environment, with a reference video reserved for evaluation. Agents must interpret the brief, inspect the available assets, select and arrange footage, coordinate picture and sound, and render the final deliverable. We score each output with tests of delivery, content and brief compliance, including a quality test calibrated on blinded human preference, and report the human judgments separately. This protocol accommodates multiple valid editorial solutions while assessing both explicit requirements and viewing experience. Together, these assignments test audiovisual understanding, temporal reasoning, sustained tool use, and the interdependent creative decisions required to turn raw material into a coherent finished edit.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了Timeline-Bench(时间线-Bench),这是评价代理商完成视频编辑任务的基准,从原始制作材料到完成视频. Timeline-Bench评估代理商是否能够执行在电影制作、文件制作、广告和数字媒体中遇到的工作流程,包括从访谈中构建一个叙事,从多个镜头组装场景,从混合视听资产中制作宣传录像。 基准中的每一项任务由源材料的收集,具体项目的简介,以及可复制的执行环境来界定,其中的参考视频保留供评价. 代理人必须解释案情摘要、检查现有资产、选择和安排录像、协调图片和声音以及制作最后交付品。 我们通过对交付、内容和短暂遵守的测试,包括根据盲目的人类偏好进行质量测试,对每项产出进行评分,并分别报告人类的判断。 该协议在评估明确要求和观看经验的同时,兼顾多种有效的编辑解决方案. 这些任务共同检验视听理解、时间推理、持续使用工具以及将原材料转化为连贯的完成编辑所需的相互依存的创造性决定。

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is structured as follows. We first describe Timeline-Bench ’s construction and evaluation protocol. We then benchmark frontier LLMs and agents on 56 editing assignments. The best agent resolves 15 of the 56 tasks ( Figure 1 a ). Finally, we analyze failure modes to inform future LLM and agent development, and compare harnesses, editorial guidance and computer use in Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 本文件其余部分的结构如下。 我们首先描述了时光线-奔驰的构建和评价协议。 然后,我们以56项编辑任务为基准,衡量前沿法学硕士和代理商。 最佳代理解决了56项任务中的15项(图1a)。 最后,我们分析失败模式,为今后的LLM和代理开发提供信息,并比较附录一中的利用、编辑指导和计算机使用。

blocks.en: 2 Timeline-Bench
blocks.zh: 2 时间线-奔驰

blocks.en: A Timeline-Bench task consists of an edit brief, source assets, a Docker image, a set of tests, and a time limit ( Figure 2 ). The brief describes the video the agent must produce, while the Docker image provides the tools and dependencies needed to complete the assignment. The tests assess whether the rendered video meets the technical specifications and satisfies the brief’s content requirements. A task is successfully completed when all required tests pass and the benchmark performance is measured by the percentage of assigned tasks that are successfully completed. Evaluation focuses on the final video, allowing agents to choose their own workflow and produce different valid edits. Given the brief and source assets, an agent must inspect the material, select and arrange clips, coordinate the picture and sound, and export the requested video within the allotted time.
blocks.zh: 一个Timeline-Bench任务包括编辑简报,源资产,一个Docker图像,一套测试,以及一个时间限制(图2 ). 简报描述了代理商必须制作的视频,而Docker图像提供了完成任务所需的工具和依赖性. 测试评估所提供的录像是否符合技术规格,是否符合简报的内容要求。 当所有要求的测试都通过时,一项任务就能够顺利完成,基准性能以成功完成的任务的百分比来衡量。 评价侧重于最终视频,使代理商能够选择自己的工作流程,并产生不同的有效编辑. 鉴于简短和来源资产,代理人必须检查材料,选择和安排剪辑,协调图片和声音,并在规定的时间内输出所要求的视频。

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: We construct Timeline-Bench from 56 editing assignments drawn from three sources: 11 purchased project packages from EditStock 1 1 1 https://editstock.com , 15 publicly available editing projects from Cinestudy 2 2 2 https://cinestudy.org , and 30 newly commissioned projects from a professional video-editing agency. The agency supplied raw footage and finished reference edits. For Cinestudy, a professional editor selected reference edits from submissions linked publicly in the project-page comments, considering editing quality and availability. We prepare each assignment by organizing the available footage, audio, graphics, and supporting documents, and writing a brief that specifies the editorial objectives and delivery requirements.
blocks.zh: 我们从来自三个来源的56项编辑任务中构建了Timeline-Bench:从EditStock 1 1 1 https://editstock.com 购买了11个项目包,从Cinestudy 2 2 https://cinestudy.org 建造了15个可公开查阅的编辑项目,以及从专业视频编辑机构新委托的30个项目。 该机构提供了原始镜头并完成了参考编辑. 对于Cinestudy,一名专业编辑从项目页面评论中公开链接的呈件中选定参考编辑,同时考虑到编辑质量和可用性。 我们通过整理现有的录像、音频、图形和辅助文件,以及撰写一份简要说明,具体说明编辑目标和交付要求,来准备每项任务。

blocks.en: 2.2 Verification
blocks.zh: 2.2 核查

blocks.en: We consider a task verified when its assignment is internally consistent, each of its tests has been validated against outputs with a known reference, and the agent has no access to the reference edit.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,如果任务在内部是一致的,就应核实一项任务,每项测试都根据已知的参考产出进行了验证,而代理人无法查阅参考编辑。

blocks.en: Assignment review. A task is well-specified if its brief describes an edit that the source assets can support and that the reference edit exemplifies. To confirm this, each brief was revised over several review rounds, after which a professional editor checked all 56 assignments for consistency between the brief, the source assets, and the reference edit (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 任务审查。 如果一个任务简短地描述了源资产可以支持的编辑和引用编辑的示例,则该任务会非常具体. 为证实这一点,每一份简报经过几轮审查后都作了修订,之后一名专业编辑检查了所有56项任务,以确定简报、来源资产和参考编辑之间的一致性(附录B)。

blocks.en: Test validation. A test is valid if it accepts outputs that have the property it checks and rejects outputs that do not. Each task therefore ships a mechanical oracle, a deliberately low-craft render of the source assets that meets the delivery specification, on which the delivery tests ( Section 3.1 ) are validated. The content and brief tests are validated on the reference edit, which passes all the content tests and all the brief tests. To confirm that these tests also reject defective outputs, we construct single-defect controls from real edits, for example, by muting the sound, blacking out the opening, reordering sections, or freezing the picture.
blocks.zh: 测试验证. 如果测试接受有其检查属性的输出,并拒绝不检查的输出,则测试是有效的。 因此,每项任务都运载了符合交付规格的机械甲骨文、故意低工艺化的源资产,对交付试验(第3.1节)加以验证。 内容和简短测试通过参考编辑验证,通过所有内容测试和所有简短测试. 为了确认这些测试也拒绝有缺陷的输出,我们从真实编辑中构建单一缺陷控制器,例如通过调音,关闭开关,重新排序,或者冻结图片.

blocks.en: Reference isolation. An agent should not be able to pass a task by recovering its reference edit. Reference edits are stored separately from the task inputs and are never staged in the container. Agents may use the internet to consult tool documentation, but the briefs prohibit retrieving finished edits, and the traces of all agent runs contain no web fetch and no access to a reference edit (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 参考隔离. 代理不应通过恢复引用编辑来通过任务. 引用编辑与任务输入分开存储,从不在容器中预设. 代理商可以使用互联网查阅工具文档,但简报禁止检索已完成的编辑,所有代理商运行的痕迹都包含没有网络获取和无法访问参考编辑(Appendix B ).

blocks.en: 2.3 Composition
blocks.zh: 2.3 组成

blocks.en: Timeline-Bench tasks vary widely. For example, Klug Brand Story asks for a sixty-second, interview-driven brand-story commercial from about four hours of dailies. Beauty of Delhi asks for a heritage travel commercial from 603 photographs and 14.9 seconds of camera footage, built largely from still-image sequences, photo holds and controlled crop movement. Timeline-Bench comprises approximately 33.0 hours of primary source footage; source duration ranges from 2.3 to 240.4 minutes (median 12.4), and the 41 landscape and 15 portrait deliverables have duration windows from 25 to 315 seconds (per-collection statistics in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 时间线-奔驰任务差异很大. 例如,Klug Brand Story要求从大约四小时的日报上获得一个第六十二,采访驱动的品牌故事广告. 德里的美人要求通过603张照片和14.9秒的镜头制作遗产旅行广告,这些照片和镜头主要来自静态序列、摄影机和受控作物运动。 Timeline-Bench由大约33.0小时的主源镜头组成;源片持续时间为2.3至240.4分钟(中位数 12.4),41幅景观和15幅肖像作品的可完成时间窗口为25至315秒(附录A中的收集统计).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Editing skills required across tasks. Each bar counts the tasks whose brief, paperwork or supplied material requires the skill.
blocks.zh: 图3:各种任务所需的编辑技能。 每个酒吧都计算需要技能的简短、书面或材料。

blocks.en: The assignments span narrative scenes, documentaries, interviews, action sequences, trailers, product advertisements, personal-branding videos, and lifestyle and travel films. A typical task requires seven of the 16 editing skills in Figure 3 (range 1–10), and 54 of the 56 tasks need at least one skill from each family. Following a script (53 tasks), music (46), dialog or voice-over editing (45) and titles, captions, or other on-screen text (45) are required almost everywhere, whereas take selection (30), sound effects (20), dual-system sync (7) and VFX compositing (7) appear in fewer tasks. The collections differ: every UGC task requires captions, color matching and reframing for portrait delivery, which almost no other task does, whereas Cinestudy and EditStock tasks hold most of the ambience, dual-system sync and VFX work.
blocks.zh: 这些任务涉及叙事场景、纪录片、采访、动作序列、拖车、产品广告、个人品牌录像、生活方式和旅行电影。 一个典型的任务需要图3(范围1-10)中的16个编辑技能中的7个,56个任务中的54个需要每个家庭至少1个技能。 根据脚本(53项任务)、音乐(46项)、对话或语音编辑(45项)以及标题、标题或其他屏幕文本(45项),几乎无处不在需要,而选择(30项)、声音效果(20项)、双系统同步(7)和VFX复合(7)则较少出现在任务中。 藏品不同:每个UGC任务都需要字幕,色彩匹配和重塑来进行肖像传递,这几乎没有其他任务做,而Cinestudy和EditStock任务则掌握了大部分的氛围,双系统同步和VFX工作.

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 评价

blocks.en: Agent benchmarks often decide success with tests alone, because their tasks specify an acceptable end state ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . In video editing, many different edits satisfy the same brief, so tests of its requirements are necessary but cannot establish quality. We therefore evaluate each output in three ways. First, tests check that the edit is a valid delivery and meets the brief’s explicit requirements ( Section 3.1 ). Second, a blind study of human preference has video editors compare each output with its task’s reference edit ( Section 3.2 ). Third, a quality test has multimodal LLM judges make the same comparison, calibrated on the human judgments ( Section 3.3 ); an output that passes it and all other tests resolves its task.
blocks.zh: 代理基准往往单靠测试来决定成功,因为他们的任务规定了可接受的结束状态(Jimenez等人,2024年;Merrill等人,2026年)。 在视频编辑中,许多不同的编辑满足了同样的简短,因此对其要求的测试是必要的,但不能建立质量. 因此,我们以三种方式评价每项产出。 第一,检查编辑是否有效并符合案情摘要的明确要求(第3.1节)。 第二,对人类偏好进行盲目研究,可以使视频编辑将每项产出与其任务的参考编辑进行比较(第3.2节)。 第三,质量测试由多式联运LLM法官根据人类判断进行同样的比较(第3.3节);通过测试的产出和所有其他测试解决了它的任务。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Resolution Rate
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务解决 费率

blocks.en: An output resolves its task only if it passes every test. The tests inspect only the delivered video and are of four kinds. Four delivery tests per task check that the file exists and that its video stream, duration and audio stream match the brief. Six content tests , shared by all tasks, reject degenerate edits such as mostly silent, frozen or looped ones (Appendix C ). Brief tests , one to six per task and 180 in total, check what the brief explicitly requires, such as using a supplied voice-over or keeping a scene order. Of these, 153 are programmatic: code matches the edit’s frames and soundtrack against the task’s source clips and recordings to find which ones it uses and where, reads its on-screen text with OCR (PP-OCR via RapidOCR; Du et al., 2020 ) and transcribes its speech (Whisper small via faster-whisper; Radford et al., 2023 ). Each such test then checks one of these facts, for example that a required line is spoken, that the supplied voice-over is heard or that clips appear in the required order. The other 27 brief tests concern visible content and are decided by a two-of-three majority of model judges (Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5; Google, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026d ; Appendix E ). Finally, the quality test compares the edit with its task’s reference edit ( Section 3.3 ). Each agent runs once on each of the 56 tasks, and its task resolution rate is the share of tasks it resolves. A missing output resolves nothing.
blocks.zh: 一个输出只有在通过每个测试时才能解决它的任务. 测试只检查交付的录像,分为四种。 每项任务都要进行四次交付测试,检查文件是否存在,其视频流,持续时间和音频流与简报相符. 六个内容测试 , 由所有任务共享 , 拒绝被扭曲的编辑, 如大多是沉默、 冻结或循环的编辑 (Appendix C ) 。 简短测试,每个任务1至6次,总共180次,检查简报明确要求什么,例如使用提供的语音或维持场景秩序。 其中153个是程序化的:代码与任务的源剪辑和录音相匹配编辑的框架和音轨,以便找到它使用的和在哪里与OCR一起阅读其屏幕上文本(PP-OCR通过RapidOCR;Du等人,2020年),并翻录其语音(Whisper small通过更快的Whisper;Radford等人,2023年)。 然后,每次这种测试都检查其中的一个事实,例如,有人讲了所要求的一行话,有人听到所提供的声音,或者按规定的顺序出现片段。 其他27个简短测试涉及可见内容,由模型法官的三分之二多数决定(Gemini 3.8 Flash,GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5;Google,2026b;OpenAI,2026a;Anthropic,2026d;附录E )。 最后,质量测试将编辑与其任务的参考编辑(第3.3节)进行比较。 每一个代理运行在56项任务中的每一个任务上一次,其任务解析率是它所解决的任务的比例. 缺少的输出解决不了任何问题。

blocks.en: 3.2 Human Preference Study
blocks.zh: 3.2 人类优先研究

blocks.en: In a blind pairwise study, 43 professional video editors compared each delivered output with its task’s reference edit. They were paid hourly, independently of their answers, and report an average of at least two years of professional experience (Appendix F ). The two edits appear as “Version A” and “Version B” in random order ( Figure 7 ), next to a one-line statement of the project’s audience and purpose. Human editors do not see the brief, the task title, the agent or other human editors’ answers. They answer “Considering the complete viewing experience, which version would you choose for this project?” with A preferred , B preferred or no meaningful preference , or mark the pair cannot assess with a reason; we exclude those. Answers unlock only after both videos have played to the end at normal speed with sound, and the seek bar stays hidden until each video’s first full viewing. Three distinct human editors judge each of the 863 pairs, giving 2,589 judgments, of which 2,582 are marked assessable. An agent’s win-or-tie rate , as in GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) , is the share of judgments in which a human editor prefers its edit or has no meaningful preference, averaged within each task and then over tasks.
blocks.zh: 在盲目双向研究中,43名专业视频编辑将每个交付的产出与其任务的参考编辑进行比较。 他们每小时领取工资,不考虑他们的答案,并报告平均至少两年的专业经验(附录F)。 这两个编辑部分按随机顺序(图7)作为 " Version A " 和 " Version B " ,放在项目受众和目的的单行说明旁边。 人类编辑看不到简报、任务标题、代理人或其他人类编辑的答案。 他们回答“考虑到完整的观看经验,你会为这个项目选择哪一个版本? ”A首选、B首选或没有有意义的偏好,或者标出对等不能有任何理由评估;我们排除了这些。 只有在两段视频以正常速度播放后, 863对各有3名不同的人类编辑判断,给出了2,589项判决,其中2,582项可进行标记评估. 例如GDPval(Patwardhan 等人, 2026年), 代理商的双向或双向比率是人类编辑喜欢编辑或没有实质偏好的判决比例,

blocks.en: 3.3 Quality Test
blocks.zh: 3.3 质量 测试

blocks.en: The quality test asks whether an edit is at least as good as its task’s reference edit. Three multimodal LLM judges, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, score each edit separately, without seeing the other version. Like the human editors, they see the one-line statement of audience and purpose but not the brief. Additionally, they receive the study’s written rubric of what makes an edit acceptable (Appendix D.1 ) and rate the edit from 1 to 10 overall and on story and assembly, pacing, picture, sound and graphics, which we combine into one score (Appendix D.2 ). Gemini 3.8 Flash watches the edit with sound. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 accept only text and images, so they read contact sheets of one frame per second instead, together with four measurements computed from the file: cuts per minute from a shot-boundary detector (our re-implementation of PySceneDetect’s adaptive detector; Castellano, 2026 ), the longest stretch of static picture, integrated loudness (EBU R128, measured with FFmpeg) and the share of silent runtime. Because judges use the 1-to-10 scale differently, we convert each judge’s scores to z-scores, using that judge’s mean and standard deviation over the 919 videos in the study (863 agent edits and 56 reference edits), and keep these constants fixed for new submissions. The panel score of an edit is the average of its three z-scores.
blocks.zh: 质量测试询问编辑是否至少与其任务的参考编辑一样好。 三位多模式LLM评委,双子座3.8 Flash,GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5分别评分,没有看到其他版本. 和人类编辑一样,他们看到观众和目的的单行声明,而不是简报. 此外,他们还收到研究报告中可以接受编辑内容的书面标题(附录D.1),并将编辑内容从总体的1到10以及故事和组装、节奏、图片、声音和图形评分(附录D.2)。 双子座 3.8 Flash用声音观看编辑. GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5只接受文字和图像,因此他们阅读了每秒一个帧的接触表,同时从文件中计算出四个测量结果:从一个射线探测器(我们重新执行PyScene Detective的适应性探测器;Castellano, 2026年),静态画面最长的伸展,集成音效(EBU R128,用FFmpeg测量)和静态运行时间的比例. 因为法官使用1比10的比分不同,所以我们将每位法官的分数转换为z比分,使用该法官对研究中的919个视频(863名代理编辑和56名参考编辑)的平均值和标准偏差,并将这些常数固定在新提交材料上。 一个编辑的面板分数是其三个z分数的平均值.

blocks.en: The test passes when the agent edit’s panel score exceeds the reference edit’s by at least the tie margin of the task’s collection. A margin is fitted on a collection’s study pairs: it is set so that the test’s pass rate comes as close as possible to the human win-or-tie rate without exceeding it. Because the panel score averages z-scores, margins are measured in judge standard deviations; one judge standard deviation is 1.0 to 1.5 points on the 1-to-10 scale. We fit margins in two ways. For new submissions, which have no human judgments, the margins are fitted once on all 2,582 assessable judgments and then frozen: 0.30 (Cinestudy), 0.52 (Commercial), 0.21 (EditStock) and 1.54 (UGC) (Appendix D ). For the results we report, fitting on an agent’s own judgments would be circular, so each agent is scored with margins refitted per collection without its own judgments (leave-one-agent-out). These held-out margins stay within 0.09 of the frozen values. All margins are positive, so an agent edit must score higher than its reference edit to pass.
blocks.zh: 当代理编辑的面板分数超过参考编辑时, 测试会通过, 至少是任务收藏的平比值 。 一个比值被安装在收藏的书本对上:这个比值的设定是为了让测试的通过率尽可能接近人类的双向或双向速率而不会超过它。 因为面板的得分平均值为z-分,所以差值在判断标准差中进行测量;1名判断标准差在1比10的比分上为1.0到1.5分. 我们从两个方面适应边际。 对于没有人力判决的新提交案,在所有2 582项可评估判决上一次加差,然后冻结:0.30(Cinestudy)、0.52(Commercial)、0.21(EditStock)和1.54(UGC)(附录D)。 对于我们报告的结果来说,根据代理商自己的判断是循环性的,因此每个代理商每集的评分都以利润率重置,而无需自己判断(leave-one-agent-out). 这些被搁置的边际不超过冻结值的0.09。 所有边距均为正值,因此代理编辑的得分必须高于其引用编辑的得分才能通过.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate 16 agents. An agent is a model running in a harness , the program that gives the model its tools and executes its commands. Each agent attempts each task once, giving 896 runs .
blocks.zh: 我们评估了16名特工 一个代理是一个运行在牵引器中的模型,这个程序给模型提供工具并执行其命令. 每一个特工都尝试过一次 给896跑步

blocks.en: 4.1 Agents
blocks.zh: 4.1 代理人

blocks.en: An agent’s result depends on both its model and its harness, and model developers tune their own harnesses for their own models. We therefore run ten models in one open-source harness, OpenCode 1.18.31 ( OpenCode, 2026 ) : GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026c ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( Google, 2026a ) , Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google, 2026b ) , DeepSeek Flash ( DeepSeek, 2026 ) , Grok 4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) , GLM 5.3 Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) and Qwen 3.8 Max ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . Four of these models also run in their developers’ own harnesses: GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra in Codex CLI 0.155.1 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , and Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Opus 5 in Claude Code 2.1.278 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) . We use unmodified releases of all three harnesses, and every model runs at the highest reasoning effort its provider offers (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 一个代理商的结果既取决于它的模型,也取决于它的利用,而模型开发者则调整自己的模型。 因此,我们在一个开源带中运行十种型号,OpenCode 1.18.31(OpenCode,2026年):GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026a),GPT-5.6 Sol(OpenAI,2026b),Claude Fable 5.1(Anthropic,2026b),Claude Opus 5(Anthropic,2026c),双子座3.1 Pro预览(Google,2026a),双子座3.8 Flash(Google,2026b),DeepSeek Flash(Deep Seek,2026),GLM 5.3 Flash(Zai,2026)和Quen 3.8 Max(Quen Team,2026). 其中4个型号也运行在开发者自己的操纵器中:GPT-5.6 Sol和GPT-6 Astra在Codex CLI 0.155.1 (OpenAI, 2025)中运行,克劳德Fable 5.1和Claude Opus 5在Claude Code 2.1.278 (Anthropic, 2026a)中运行. 我们使用未经修改的释放所有三条绳索,每个模型都以其提供者提供的最高推理努力运行(附录H)。

blocks.en: Curated guidance. One agent adds editorial guidance to GPT-6 Astra in Codex CLI. It receives 1,909 words of general editing advice: a skill file ( SKILL.md ) and six reference notes on reading the brief and footage, planning and building the edit, reviewing and delivering it, and using the installed video tools. The advice contains no task-specific answers. A one-line note in the agent’s instruction file ( AGENTS.md ) says where to find it; everything else matches the unguided agent.
blocks.zh: 释导. 一个特工在Codex CLI中增加了GPT-6 Astra的编辑指导. 它收到1 909字的一般编辑建议:一个技能文件(SKILL.md)和6个参考说明,内容是阅读简报和镜头,规划和建立编辑、审查和交付,以及使用已安装的视频工具。 咨询意见中没有针对具体任务的答案。 代理指令文件(AGENTS.md)中的一条单行说明说在哪里找到它;其他一切都与无导线的代理匹配.

blocks.en: Computer use. Another agent runs GPT-6 Astra in Codex CLI’s computer-use mode, in which it sees the screen and controls the mouse and keyboard but has no shell, so it cannot use command-line tools. It edits in the free edition of DaVinci Resolve ( Blackmagic Design, 2026 ) on macOS. Its briefs are the same except for the tool instructions, which tell it to work in Resolve, and a Resolve project is already open with the task’s media imported.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用. 另一个代理在Codex CLI的计算机使用模式下运行了GPT-6 Astra,在其中它看到屏幕并控制鼠标和键盘,但没有 shell,因此它不能使用命令行工具. 它在macOS上的免费版DaVinci Resolution(黑魔法设计,2026年)中编辑. 它的简介是一样的,除了工具指示外,工具指示指示它“决心”工作,而“决心”项目已经随着任务媒体的导入而开放。

blocks.en: 4.2 Environment and Budgets
blocks.zh: 4.2 环境和预算

blocks.en:
The coding agents run in Linux containers with the tools an editor working in code needs: FFmpeg, Python and Node, the programmatic video frameworks Remotion and HyperFrames with a headless browser, Poppler for PDF paperwork, and a transcription command (AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro; versions in Appendix H ). Every run starts from a fresh harness state and the same input files, which are checked against their SHA-256 hashes before the run. Each run has a 300-minute limit and a whole machine to itself (32 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory), with no CPU or memory limits on the container. Agents may use the internet, but the briefs forbid retrieving finished edits, and we audit the traces for such retrievals ( Section 2.2 ). Tasks are packaged in the Harbor format ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) , which fixes each task’s brief, inputs and delivery tests
(Appendix H ).
blocks.zh:
编码代理在Linux容器中运行,其工具是一位从事代码需要的编辑器:FFmpeg,Python和Node,程序视频框架Remotion和HyperFrames,带有无头浏览器,Poppler用于PDF文件,以及一个抄写命令(AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro;版本为附录H). 每一次运行都从新鲜的吊带状态和相同的输入文件开始,在运行前对照他们的SHA-256散列检查. 每次运行都有300分钟的限速,并有整台机器到自己身上(32 vCPU和256 GB的内存),容器上没有CPU或内存的限制. 代理商可能使用互联网,但简报禁止检索已完成的编辑,我们审核这些检索的痕迹(第2.2节)。 任务以港湾格式(港湾框架小组,2026年)包装,其中确定了每项任务的简要说明、投入和交付测试
(附录H).

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 1 a shows the task resolution rate of every agent, and Table 1 gives the numbers (with confidence intervals in Table 8 ). GPT-6 Astra in Codex CLI with curated editorial guidance resolves the most tasks, 15 of 56 (26.8%), followed by Claude Opus 5 in Claude Code at 23.2% and by GPT-6 Astra in Codex CLI and in OpenCode at 21.4% each. With one run per task, each agent’s rate has a 95% CI of about ± \pm 11 points, so the agents near the top cannot be told apart. Overall, 125 of the 896 runs resolve their task (14.0%, 95% CI 11.7–16.4%), and Section 6 examines where the others fail. The median runtime per run ranges from 16 to 61 minutes and is unrelated to resolution (Spearman ρ = 0.15 \rho=0.15 ). Among the 12 agents with recorded costs, from $0.13 to $41.27 per run, more expensive agents tend to resolve more tasks ( ρ = 0.79 \rho=0.79 ), but the best agent, GPT-6 Astra with curated guidance, costs an estimated $9.76 per run (Codex CLI records only tokens; Appendix H.3 ).
blocks.zh: 图1 a 显示每种剂的任务分辨率,表1显示数字(在表8中为信任间隔)。 Codex CLI中的GPT-6 Astra 配有编译指导解决了大多数任务,其中15项为56项(26.8%),其次是Claude Code中的Claude Opus 5 占23.2%,GPT-6 Astra 则分别占21.4%。 每个任务运行一次后,每个代理商的费率为95%的CI,大约为±\pm 11分,因此无法区分顶端附近的代理商. 总体来说,896人中有125人完成了他们的任务(14.0%,95%CI 11.7–16.4%),第6节审查了其他失败之处。 每次运行的平均运行时间为16至61分钟,与分辨率无关(Spearman ^ = 0.15\rho= 0.15). 在有记录成本的12名代理商中,每跑0.13美元至41.27美元,较昂贵的代理商往往会解决更多的任务(ρ = 0.79\rho= 0.79),但最好的代理商GPT-6 Astra有管理指导,每跑估计需要9.76美元(Codex CLI只记录符;附录H.3).

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results , one run per task. Tests : runs, of 56, passing every test but the quality test. Res. : resolution rate. Human : human win-or-tie rate. With CIs in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 表1:主要成果,每项任务进行一次。 测试:运行,56次,每次通过测试但质量测试。 决议:分辨率。 人类:人类的胜负率。 表8列有犯罪调查。

blocks.en: Human preference. Human editors prefer the reference edit in 83.5% of the 2,582 assessable judgments, the agent edit in 11.1%, and have no meaningful preference in 5.5%. The win-or-tie rate averages 16.5% over agents. It ranges from 24.4% for GPT-6 Astra with curated guidance, 8.3 points of which come from ties, to 4.0% for Qwen 3.8 Max.
blocks.zh: 人类喜欢。 在2,582项可评判断中,83.5%的参考编辑,11.1%的代理编辑,5.5%的参考编辑没有有意义的偏好。 中和率平均比特工高16.5%. 其范围从GPT-6 Astra的24.4%和经曲导的8.3分,其中从领带到Quen 3.8 Max的4.0%.

blocks.en: Single judgments are noisy (Krippendorff’s α = 0.10 \alpha=0.10 ), but per-agent rates are reliable (Spearman–Brown reliability 0.84 with three human editors per pair), robust to leaving out any human editor (Spearman ρ ≥ 0.96 \rho\geq 0.96 ) and unaffected by the order of the two versions (Appendices F and G.1 ). The resolution rate tracks the human win-or-tie rate across agents ( Figure 1 b ). With margins refit without each agent’s own judgments, the two rates differ by 3.0 points on average and by 7.2 at most (Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview), with Spearman ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 and Pearson r = 0.93 r=0.93 over the 16 agents.
blocks.zh: 单一判断很吵(Krippendorff的α = 0.10\alpha = 0.10),但每个代理人的收费率是可靠的(Spearman - Brown可靠性0.84,每对有3名人类编辑),强势地将任何人类编辑器排除在外(Spearman ^ 0.96\rho\geq 0.96),不受两个版本顺序的影响(附录F和G.1). 解析率跟踪人类的双键率(图1b)。 在不经过每个代理人自己判断的情况下,对边际调整后,这两个比率平均为3.0分,最多为7.2分(Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview),Spearman $ = 0.93\rho = 0.93,Pearson r = 0.93 = 16名代理人。

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: In this section, we ask where runs fail, why human editors prefer the reference edits and how agents work (full analysis in Appendix J , methods in Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们询问运行失败之处,为什么人类编辑更喜欢参考编辑以及代理如何工作(附录J中的全面分析,附录K中的方法).

blocks.en: Figure 4: Most unresolved runs pass every test and fail only the quality test. (a) The 56 runs of each agent by the first test they fail ( Section 3.1 ); quality-test failures are split into near misses (less than 0.25 panel standard deviations below the margin) and far misses, resolved runs into wins and ties. (b) How far each agent’s quality-test failures fall below the margin, in judge standard deviations: median (dot) and interquartile range (bar); the shaded band marks near misses.
blocks.zh: 图4:大多数未解决的测试都通过每次测试,只通过质量测试。 (a) 每名代理人在第一次测试失败之前的56次运行(第3.1节);质量测试失败被分成接近误差(低于差值的0.25面板标准差)和远误差,解答成胜负和联系。 (b) 在判断标准偏差:中位值(点)和间位值(栏);阴影带标记接近误差时,每名代理人的质量测试失败在多大程度上低于差值。

blocks.en: The quality test is where agents lose. Of the 771 unresolved runs, 562 (73%) pass the delivery, content and brief tests and fail only the quality test ( Figure 4 a); for 15 of the 16 agents this accounts for 61–90% of their losses, the exception being Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, which loses 35 of its 55 unresolved runs to earlier tests. Most of these failures are narrow ( Figure 4 b): the median one falls 0.82 judge standard deviations short of the margin, about one point on the 1-to-10 scale, and 0.47 to 0.78 for the eight agents that resolve at least 10 tasks, against 2.02 for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. Because so many runs sit near the bar, the number resolved depends on where the margin is set, but the order of agents largely does not: lowering every margin by 0.1 standard deviations would resolve 27 more runs, and although agents a run or two apart can swap places, including the top two, the ranking barely moves (Spearman 0.96).
blocks.zh: 质量测试是代理商输掉的地方. 在771次未解决的运行中,562次(73%)通过了交付、内容和简短测试,只通过了质量测试(图4a);对于16名代理商中15次,这占其损失的61-90%,例外是双子座3.1 Pro Preview,在55次未解决的运行中损失了35次到更早的测试。 这些失败大多是狭义的(图4b):中位数1跌0.82,判断标准偏差低于比值,在1比10的比值上约为1分,解决至少10项任务的8名代理商为0.47比0.78,而双子座3.1 Pro Preview为2.02. 因为如此多的跑步都坐落在吧台附近,所以解决的数字取决于差值的设定地点,但代理商的顺序基本没有:将每个差值降低0.1标准差就能解决27个以上的跑步,虽然代理商一个或两个分开可以互换位置,包括前两个,但排名几乎没有移动(Spearman 0.96).

blocks.en: Figure 5: Agents produce clean assemblies but not finished edits, and check for defects rather than quality. (a) Share of the human notes preferring the reference edit that name a problem of the agent edit or a strength of the reference edit. (b) Agent edit relative to the reference edit of the same task (median over tasks of the mean ratio; 95% task-bootstrap interval). (c) Phases of the native actions of the 15 code agents over the course of a run. (d) What agents report fixing after checking their own render (343 reports) and what human editors cite in notes preferring the reference edit.
blocks.zh: 图5:代理人生产干净的组件,但没有完成编辑,并检查缺陷而不是质量。 (a) 偏爱引用编辑的人类注释份额,该名称是代理编辑的问题或引用编辑的强度。 (b) 相对于同一任务的参考编辑的代理编辑(在平均比例的任务上居中;95%的任务-陷阱间隔)。 (c) 15名密码人员在运行过程中的本地行动阶段。 (d) 哪些代理人在检查自己的构件后报告固定(343份报告),哪些人类编辑在注释中更倾向于参考编辑。

blocks.en: Human editors prefer the reference edit for craft that the agent edit lacks. We coded all 1,271 human editors’ notes with Claude Opus 5.5 into 24 categories (second-coder κ = 0.84 \kappa=0.84 , author-audited; Appendix K.1 ). Of the 1,101 notes explaining a preference for the reference edit, 95% cite a strength of the reference edit but only 44% name any problem in the agent edit ( Figure 5 a). The strengths are finishing and editorial judgment, such as polish, shot selection, graphics, and transitions; only audio defects and repeated footage are main agent errors. Measurements agree: paired by task, agents change shots only 0.72 times as often as the reference edit and hold their longest static shot 1.5 times as long ( Figure 5 b), and human editors penalize the slower pace but not a faster one. Agents win on story, not on graphics (“[agent] gets into the heist story more directly”). Graphics decides 91% of tagged UGC judgments, story 84–86% in the narrative collections. Stronger agents fail more subtly. When humans reject an agent edit, their notes name a defect that a content test could catch, such as an audio glitch or repeated footage, for 10% of the six highest-rated agents but for 19% of the three weakest code agents (Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Qwen 3.8 Max and GLM 5.3 Flash). The computer-use agent is worst, at 28%: it leaves slates, crew talk or retakes in 18.5% of its rejected edits (“In [agent], you can hear the command ‘Action!’ That’s not okay.”).
blocks.zh: 人类编辑更喜欢代理编辑缺少的工艺的参考编辑. 我们用Claude Opus 5.5把所有1,271名人类编辑的笔记编码为24个类别(第二编码为0.84\kappa=0.84,作者审计;附录K.1)。 在1,101个解释倾向于引用编辑的注释中,95%引用引用编辑的强度,但代理编辑中仅44%提到任何问题(图5a)。 优点是完成和编辑判断,如抛光,镜头选择,图形,和过渡;只有音频缺陷和重复镜头是主要代理错误. 测量方法一致:按任务配对,代理人改变镜头的次数只有参考编辑时的0.72倍,并保持最长的静态镜头的1.5倍长(图5b),而人类编辑则惩罚速度较慢但不快. 代理商在故事上胜出,而不是在图形上胜出(“[代理人]更直接地进入抢劫故事”)。 图片决定91%的标注UGC判断, 更强大的特工更会失败 当人类拒绝一个代理编辑时,他们的笔记将一个内容测试可以捕捉到的缺陷命名为一个缺陷,例如音频故障或重复的镜头,对于6个最高评级的代理中10%,但对于3个最弱代码代理中19%(Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview,Quen 3.8 Max和GLM 5.3 Flash). 电脑使用代理人最糟糕,占28%:它在其被拒绝编辑的18.5%(在[代理人]中,你可以听到命令‘行动! 这可不行。”

blocks.en: Difficulty belongs to tasks. Agents tend to fail the same tasks: 35 tasks are resolved by no agent, whereas only about 5 would be if each agent’s successes fell on random tasks. Tasks also differ more than agents do. If we model each human vote as depending on the agent’s skill and the task’s difficulty (a Rasch model), task difficulty varies 2.6 times as much as agent skill, and even the best agent is more likely to lose than to win or tie on 54 of the 56 tasks (Appendix J.3 ). The collection explains half of this: the human win-or-tie rate falls from 28.7% on Cinestudy to 6.8% on UGC. Within a collection, however, no task property or required editing skill predicts difficulty, and no agent is especially strong at particular skills.
blocks.zh: 难度属于任务. 代理人往往不能完成同样的任务:没有代理人解决35项任务,而如果每个代理人的成功落在随机的任务上,则只有大约5项任务。 任务也比代理人不同。 如果我们把每个人的投票模拟成取决于代理人的技巧和任务难度(Rasch模型),任务难度与代理人技能相差2.6倍,即使是最好的代理人也比在56项任务中的54项(附录J.3)中获胜或打平更可能输. 藏品解释了其中一半:人类的双倍或双倍率从Cinestudy的28.7%下降到UGC的6.8%. 然而,在一个集合中,没有任务属性或所需的编辑技能预言困难,也没有一个代理人特别强于特定技能.

blocks.en: Agents look first, render late and check for defects. Code agents spend 54% of their 111,636 native actions perceiving the source and 17% verifying their own render, but only 9% building; 98% of their perception precedes the first render, which comes 72–90% of the way through a run ( Figure 5 c). They see footage as stills (83% of native reads open frames or contact sheets) and hear it as transcripts and level measurements; GPT agents in Codex CLI even print audio excerpts as base64 text, in up to 55 of 56 runs. Checking is nearly universal (86–100% of runs for 14 of 15 code agents) and tracks resolution across agents ( ρ = 0.73 \rho=0.73 ), but it targets form: only 5.5% of the problems agents report after a check concern pacing, story or shot choice, against 66% of human editors’ notes ( Figure 5 d). Agents’ final messages claim full success in 93% of runs, including 95.5% of edits that fail a test.
blocks.zh: 特工们先看 迟到再检查缺陷 密码代理花费了111,636项土著行动中的54%,以及17%核实了他们自己的构件,但只有9%的建筑;98%的构件在第一次构件之前,这是72-90%的运行过程(图5c)。 他们将镜头视为静态(83%的原住民读取开放帧或接触表),并听闻为文字记录和关卡测量;Codex CLI中的GPT代理甚至将音频节录打印为基质64文本,在56个运行中多达55个. 检查几乎是普遍的(15个码剂中14个为86–100%的运行),并跟踪跨码剂的分辨率(ρ = 0.73\rho= 0.73),但它的目标是形式:只有5.5%的问题代理在检查后报告,而人为编辑的笔记只有66%(图5d)。 代理商最后的消息宣称在93%的运行中完全成功,包括95.5%的编辑未通过测试.

blocks.zh: 表2:现任代理编辑. 第6节的证据和附录J

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes that agents reliably do what a brief can state (delivering the specified video, meeting explicit requirements, keeping the timeline clean), but they cannot judge their own edits and remain weak at what a human editor adds: rhythm, shot selection and finishing.
blocks.zh: 表2总结说,特工们可靠地做了简要说明(传送指定的视频,满足明确要求,保持时间表清洁),但是他们不能判断自己的编辑,对人编辑所补充的内容仍然软弱:节奏,射击选择和完成.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Each agent runs once per task, so our intervals omit run-to-run variance. The quality test was calibrated on the same human editors’ votes that it is validated against, and it is valid per agent, not per edit (Appendix D ). The reference edits are professional edits, not certified ground truth.
blocks.zh: 每个代理每任务运行一次,所以我们的间隔省略了运行中的差异. 质量测试通过同样的人类编辑的投票进行校准,以验证它是否反对,并且每个代理人有效,而不是每个编辑有效(附录D)。 引用编辑是专业编辑,而不是经过认证的地面真实性.

blocks.en: 8 Related Work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent benchmarks. Outcome-graded agent benchmarks cover software engineering, terminal work and machine-learning research ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2026b ; Merrill et al., 2026 ; Chan et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) , and GDPval and Agents’ Last Exam extend evaluation to professional deliverables judged by experts ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) ; checklists for agent benchmarks call for frozen inputs and validated evaluators ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kapoor et al., 2025 ) . Timeline-Bench keeps outcome-graded tasks, but because an edit has no single correct answer, its quality test is calibrated on blind professional judgments.
blocks.zh: 特工基准。 结果级代理人基准包括软件工程、终端工作和机器学习研究(Jimenez等人,2024年;Deng等人,2026年b;Merrill等人,2026年;Chan等人,2025年;Starace等人,2025年),以及GDPval和代理人的最后考试,将评价范围扩大到专家判断的专业可达到的目标(Patwardhan等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年);代理人基准清单要求冻结投入和鉴定评价员(Zhu等人,2025年;Kapor等人,2025年)。 Timeline-Bench保留了结果级的任务,但由于编辑没有单一的正确答案,其质量测试是在盲目专业判断上校准的.

blocks.en: Video editing and media agents. Video benchmarks measure components of editing, such as recognizing techniques or choosing cuts from one long video ( Deng et al., 2026a ; Ogata et al., 2026 ) , or evaluate post-production operations and GUI trajectories in media software and analyze their technical failures ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Heo et al., 2026 ; Ai et al., 2026 ) ; dedicated systems build editing agents ( Sandoval-Castañeda et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Video-understanding benchmarks ask multiple-choice questions about long or audio-visual video ( Fu et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2026 ) , whereas the agents we evaluate perceive footage through still frames and transcripts. Timeline-Bench evaluates complete assignments from raw material to a delivered edit, compares coding and GUI agents, and characterizes failures of craft from editors’ notes.
blocks.zh: 视频编辑与媒体代理. 视频基准衡量编辑的组件,如识别技术或选择剪切一个长视频(Deng等人,2026a;Ogata等人,2026),或评价媒体软件的制作后操作和GUI轨迹,并分析其技术故障(Cao等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年;Ai等人,2026年);专用系统建设编辑代理(Sandoval-Castañeda等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年)。 视频理解基准对长视频或视听视频提出了多个选择问题 (Fu等人,2025年;Wu等人,2024年;Hong等人,2026年),而我们评价的特工通过静架和记录片来感知镜头. Timeline-Bench评价从原材料到交付的编辑的完整任务,比较编码和GUI代理,并描述编辑笔记中的工艺故障。

blocks.en: Judging subjective outputs. Human preference ranks systems ( Chiang et al., 2024 ; Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) , and model judges approximate it ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) but are biased by position ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) , also for video ( Ogata et al., 2026 ) . We therefore score each edit with a cross-laboratory panel calibrated on human judgments and validated per agent (Appendix N ).
blocks.zh: 判断主观产出. 人类偏好等级制度(Chiang等人,2024年;Patwardhan等人,2026年),模特评委大致(Zheng等人,2023年),但按职位偏好(Wang等人,2024年;Shi等人,2025年),也用于视频(Ogata等人,2026年). 因此,我们每次编辑都使用一个跨实验室的面板来校准人类的判断,并验证每个代理人(附录N).

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: We introduce Timeline-Bench , a benchmark of 56 complete video-editing assignments in which agents turn raw production material and a brief into finished edits. Across 16 agents, the strongest resolves 15 tasks, while the benchmark’s quality test closely tracks human preference ( ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 ), revealing that the main gap is craft rather than compliance: 562 of 771 unresolved runs pass every other requirement but fail quality. Agents cut at just 0.72× the reference pace, rely heavily on still frames and transcripts, inspect renders for technical defects rather than pacing or story, and claim success in 93% of runs. The results suggest that creative benchmarks need human-calibrated quality evaluation, while capable agents need native audio-visual perception, finishing tools, and the ability to judge creative quality, not merely correctness. We release the tasks, verifier, and per-run results to enable rigorous measurement of progress.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了时光线-奔驰(Timeline-Bench),这是56个完整的视频编辑任务的基准,其中代理商将原始制作材料和一份简报转化为完成编辑. 在16个代理人中,最强者解决了15项任务,而基准的质量测试则密切跟踪人类偏好( ^ 0.93\rho=0.93),揭示主要差距是工艺而不是遵守:771项未解决的运行中有562项通过其他要求,但质量不及格。 特工们只用0.72×的参考速度,严重依赖静态帧和记录,检查技术缺陷而不是速度或故事,并声称在93%的运行中取得了成功。 结果显示,创造性基准需要人校准的质量评价,而有能力的代理人则需要本地的视听感知,完成工具,以及判断创造性质量的能力,而不仅仅是正确性. 我们公布各项任务、核查结果和每项结果,以便能够严格衡量进展情况。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: Sections 2 – 4 define the tasks, tests, quality test, human study and agents. Appendix H gives the exact model identifiers, harness versions, reasoning settings and launch commands, Appendix B the task-verification procedure, Appendix G the statistical methods, and Appendix M the release. The project site ( https://timelinebench.tensortest.com ) and its code mirror ( https://timelinebench.tensortest.com/code ) provide the 56 Harbor tasks, whose briefs, tests and oracle solutions are byte-identical to those the coding agents were evaluated against; the verifier with its frozen constants and the reference edits’ panel scores, so that new edits can be scored without the reference edits; every per-run outcome; and a script that recomputes the automatic-evaluation results and the count-based human-study statistics without model calls, network access, media or Docker. Statistics that need per-judgment editor records, such as the two-way editor intervals, cannot be recomputed from the release, because those records are withheld to protect participants. Judges called again may answer slightly differently, since provider serving is not guaranteed to be identical over time. Media access is gated (Appendix M ) and is not needed to run the recomputation script.
blocks.zh: 第2–4节定义了任务,测试,质量测试,人类研究和代理. 附 录 H给出了精确的模型识别符,使用版本,推理设置和发射命令,附录B给出了任务核查程序,附录G给出了统计方法,附录M给出了发布. 项目网站(https://timelinebench.tensortest.com)及其代码镜(https://timelinebench.tensortest.com/code)提供了56项港务任务,其简介、测试和甲骨文解决方案与被评价的编码代理人是字节一致的;其冻结常数的核查人和参考编辑的面板分数,因此无需参考编辑即可获得新的编辑结果;每一次运行结果;以及一个脚本,在不使用模型调用、网络访问、媒体或Docker的情况下,重新计算自动评价结果和基于计数的人文研究统计数据。 需要作伪审编辑记录的统计数据,如双向编辑间隔,不能从发行中重新计算,因为这些记录是为保护参与者而扣留的. 被再次传唤的法官的答复可能略有不同,因为服务供应商在一段时间内不能保证完全相同。 媒体访问是门(Appendix M),不需要运行重算脚本.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The human study asked 43 freelance video editors for blind preference judgments between two complete edits. Human editors were recruited individually, and their pay did not depend on their answers. Before the first comparison, each human editor read an on-screen description of the task and of the interaction data recorded (playback controls, viewing coverage, answer changes, clicks, tab visibility and time spent; no camera, microphone, screen or keystrokes), and gave consent through a required acknowledgment. We did not seek institutional ethics review. The study collected expert preference judgments about non-sensitive video material, and apart from the contact details used to administer the study and the interaction data listed above, the only personal information collected was self-reported editing experience. We release only aggregate statistics and per-run vote counts; no editor identities, per-person telemetry or per-judgment records are published, and human editors’ free-text notes appear only as short anonymous excerpts in this paper.
blocks.zh: 人类研究要求43位自由职业视频编辑在两个完整的编辑之间做出盲目偏好判断. 人类编辑是单独招聘的,他们的薪水并不取决于他们的答案. 在第一次比较之前,每个人类编辑都阅读了对任务和所记录的互动数据的屏幕上描述(回放控制,观看覆盖,回答变化,点击,制表可见度和所花费的时间;没有相机,麦克风,屏幕或键盘),并通过要求的承认表示同意. 我们没有寻求机构道德审查。 该研究收集了专家对非敏感视频材料的偏好判断,除了用于管理该研究的联络细节和上述互动数据外,所收集的唯一个人信息是自报的编辑经验. 我们只发布汇总统计数据和每个运行的选票计数;没有发布编辑身份,人均遥测或伪判断记录,人类编辑的自由文字注释只出现在本文的短篇匿名摘录中.

blocks.en: The EditStock project packages were purchased under license, the commissioned productions were made for the benchmark with rights to the material, and the Cinestudy projects are publicly available editing exercises. None of the source footage, reference edits or agent outputs is redistributed publicly. Identifiable people in the commissioned material are covered by releases, and the access terms forbid identifying, profiling or imitating the people shown (Appendix M ). Our results describe the sampled agents and tasks, not the abilities or employability of video editors.
blocks.zh: EditStock项目包是根据许可证购买的,委托制作的用于基准,对材料有权利,Cinestudy项目是公开的编辑练习. 任何源片段、参考编辑或代理产出都不公开重新分配。 受委托提供的材料中可识别的人都包含在释放内容中,访问条款禁止识别、剖析或模仿所示的人(附录M)。 我们的结果描述了抽样代理人和任务,而不是视频编辑的能力或可就业性。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In this work, AI models are part of the method, and we used generative AI tools for implementation, analysis and writing. Within the method, the 16 evaluated agents are AI systems; a panel of three AI judges scores edits for the quality test and decides the judge-based brief checks ( Section 3.3 , Appendix E ); a speech-recognition model transcribes edits for code-based brief checks; the brief-test rubrics were drafted by one AI agent, adversarially reviewed by a second and verified by the authors, and are further validated by the oracle rule, single-defect controls and cross-laboratory judge agreement; two model annotators (Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5) and a third adjudicating model pass tagged the editing skills of each task, and the authors cross-checked the tags (Appendix A.1 ); Claude Opus 5.5 coded the human editors’ notes, with Claude Sonnet 5 as second coder, and labeled the agents’ final messages, and the authors checked these codes and labels (Appendix K ); and GPT-6 Astra labeled shell-command failures, and the authors checked those labels (Appendix L ). We also used generative AI tools to write and test code for the analyses and figures, to search and synthesize the literature, and to draft and edit this manuscript. Formulating mathematical claims and writing proofs are not applicable to this work. We have reviewed all AI-assisted work: every citation was checked against its arXiv, publisher or vendor record, two independent recomputations reproduce every deterministic number in the result files with no discrepancies, and the authors read and revised all AI-assisted text, code and analyses. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims or artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,AI模型是方法的一部分,我们使用了基因化的AI工具用于执行,分析和写作. 在该方法内,16名评估代理人是AI系统;由3名AI法官组成的小组为质量测试进行评分,并决定法官的简要检查(第3.3节,附录E);语音识别模型转录码为代码的简要检查;简要测试词由1名AI代理起草,由第二人进行对抗审查,并由作者进行核实,并进一步通过甲骨文规则、单一缺陷控制和跨实验室法官协议加以验证;两个模型的注释器(Claude Opus 5.5和Claude Sonnet 5)和第三个裁决模型通过标记每项任务的编辑技能,作者交叉检查标记(Appendix A.1);克劳德·奥普斯5.5为人类编辑笔记,克劳德·索内特5作为第二编码器,并给代理人的最后信息贴上标签,作者对这些代码和标签(Appendix K)进行了进一步验证;GPT-6标注贝壳命令失败,作者检查这些标签(Appix L)。 我们还使用基因AI工具来撰写和测试分析和数字的代码,搜索和合成文献,并起草和编辑这个手稿. 拟订数学索赔和书面证据不适用于这项工作。 我们审查了所有AI协助的工作:每一份引文都对照其arXiv、出版商或销售商的记录进行核对,两份独立的重写转载了结果文件中的每个确定数字,没有不一致之处,作者阅读并修订了AI协助的所有文本、代码和分析。 我们负责这项工作的最后内容,包括文本、权利主张或由遗传性大赦国际协助制作的文物。

blocks.en: Two model annotators, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5, independently tagged each of the 56 tasks with the 16 editing skills of Figure 3 . For each task they read the brief, the requirements of its brief-test rubric and an inventory of the supplied material, and every tag had to cite a short verbatim quote from this evidence. A skill counts as required only if the brief or its paperwork asks for it, or if the supplied material and the brief make it unavoidable; a skill that would merely be good practice is not tagged. The annotators agree on 831 of the 896 task–skill pairs (92.7%; Cohen’s κ = 0.85 \kappa=0.85 ). Each pass is a single call in which the judge returns integer scores from 1 to 10 for five dimensions (story and assembly, pacing, picture, sound and graphics), up to five timestamped defects, a yes-or-no answer to the acceptability question and an integer overall score from 1 to 10, where 10 is the best professional edit to expect for the project, 6 is acceptable and 3 or lower needs substantial revision.
A judge’s score of an edit is o ¯ + 0.2 ​ d ¯ \overline{o}+0.2\,\overline{d} , where o ¯ \overline{o} is the overall score and d ¯ \overline{d} the mean of the five dimension scores, both averaged over the judge’s passes (Gemini 3.8 Flash makes two); the dimension term mainly breaks ties between equal overall scores, and the defects and the acceptability answer are not used.

每一次传球都是单调,评委将整数分数从1到10对五个维度(故事和组装,节奏,图片,声音和图形),最多5倍的缺陷,对可接受问题的回答是或否,整数总分从1到10,其中10是项目预期的最佳专业编辑,6是可以接受的,3或更低级需要大量修改.

blocks.en: Only 6 of the 863 delivered videos fail a delivery test, and 762 pass every brief test. blocks.en: J.2 Why Human Editors Prefer the Reference Edits

blocks.en: Per-category shares of the notes are in Table 10 . When human editors prefer the agent edit, they tick story and assembly more often than when they reject it (84% against 72% of tagged judgments) and graphics much less often (35% against 55%). Human editors report slates, crew talk or retakes left in 18.5% of the computer-use agent’s losses against 1.4% for the six agents with the highest human win-or-tie rate, and repeated footage in 18.5% against 3.6%. An agent edit loses 6.6 points of win-or-tie per halving of its cut rate below the reference edit’s (95% CI 3.2–10.0), whereas cutting faster than the reference edit is not penalized.
blocks.zh: 附注的每个类别份额见表10。 当人类编辑更喜欢代理编辑时,他们比拒绝(84%对72%的标记判断)和图形(35%对55%)更频繁地勾选故事和组装。 人类编辑报告说,计算机使用剂损失的18.5%中留下的盘子、机组人员谈话或重取,而6名机体的双赢率最高的机体损失为1.4%,重复的机体损失为18.5%,重复的机体损失为3.6%。 代理编辑每比参考编辑(95 % CI 3.2–10.0)的剪切率降低一半,就损失6.6点,而剪切快于参考编辑则不受处罚。

blocks.en: A Rasch model of the human votes, with an ability per agent and a difficulty per task (Appendix K.2 ), places agents and tasks on one scale ( Figure 8 ). Tasks vary 2.6 times as much as agents, and on 54 of the 56 tasks even the best agent has less than even odds of a win or tie. Collection explains half of the variation in task difficulty ( η 2 = 0.51 \eta^{2}=0.51 ). Within collections, no task descriptor or required skill predicts difficulty after Holm correction (all | r | ≤ 0.24 |r|\leq 0.24 ), and once each task’s difficulty is removed, the agent-by-skill grid of win-or-tie rates is at chance level (permutation p = 0.55 p=0.55 ).

blocks.en: K.1 Coding of Human Editors’ Notes
blocks.zh: K.1 人类编辑器的编码

blocks.en: Material. Human editors answered the optional question “What most influenced your judgment?” by ticking dimensions (story and assembly, pacing, picture, sound, graphics, other), by writing a note, or both. Of the 2,582 assessable judgments, 931 have at least one ticked dimension (tagged judgments), and 1,271 have a note.
blocks.zh: 物质。 人类编辑们回答一个可选的问题“什么影响你的判断?” ,方法是刻制维度(故事和组装、速度、图片、声音、图形、其他),写一个注释,或两者兼而有之。 在2 582项可评估判决中,931项判决至少有1项(标有标记的判决),1 271项有说明。

blocks.en: Coding. Claude Opus 5.5 coded each note into claims, each with one of 24 categories ( Table 10 ), a target (agent edit, reference edit or both) and a polarity (problem or strength). Comparative praise of the preferred edit is coded as a strength of that edit, not as a problem of the other.
blocks.zh: 编码. Claude Opus 5.5将每个音符编码为索赔,每个音符包含24个类别(表10)之一,一个目标(代理编辑,参考编辑或两者兼有)和一个极性(问题或强度). 对首选编辑的比较赞誉被编码为该编辑的强度,而不是另一个问题.

blocks.en: Validation. Claude Sonnet 5 re-coded 150 random notes with the same prompt. On the presence of each category in a note, the two coders agree at a mean Cohen’s κ \kappa of 0.84 over the 19 categories with at least ten positives.
blocks.zh: 鉴定. Claude Sonnet 5重新编码了150个随机音符,并带有同样的提示. 两位编码员同意,

blocks.en: K.2 Task Difficulty and Skill Profiles
blocks.zh: K.2 任务难度和技能配置

blocks.en: Rasch model. We fitted a crossed random-effects logistic model, logit ​ p = μ + θ agent − b task \mathrm{logit}\,p=\mu+\theta_{\text{agent}}-b_{\text{task}} , to the human win-or-tie votes (863 delivered runs, three votes each) by Laplace-approximate marginal likelihood. The task standard deviation is 0.83 against 0.51 for agents, a variance ratio of 2.6.

Task features. We correlated the Rasch task difficulty with 20 task descriptors (collection, portrait delivery, requested duration, number and duration of source files, presence of a script, and the 16 editing skills), after removing collection means, with collection-stratified permutation tests and Holm correction.
blocks.zh: 任务特征. 我们把拉施任务难度与20个任务描述符(收集、肖像传送、请求的持续时间、源文件的数量和持续时间、脚本的存在以及16种编辑技能)联系起来,在删除收集手段之后,进行收集的定时测试和Holm校正。

blocks.en: Skill profiles. For each run we subtracted the mean outcome of the other 15 agents on the same task, which removes task difficulty, and compared these residuals between tasks that do and do not require each skill, within collections, testing all agent–skill cells jointly for heterogeneity by permutation.
blocks.zh: 技能简介. 在每次运行中,我们都减去了其他15名特工在同一任务上的平均结果,这消除了任务难度,并将这些剩余的任务进行比较,这些任务既需要,又不需要每种技能,在收集过程中,对所有代理人-技能细胞进行共同测试,以通过穿透来达到异质性。

blocks.en: K.3 Trajectory Phases and Process Features
blocks.zh: K.3 轨迹阶段和过程特征

blocks.en: Phase assignment. We assigned every native action of the 896 traces to one phase by rules over the tool and its arguments. Reading the brief, documentation or file listings is orienting; frame extraction, contact sheets, image reads of source frames, ffprobe of inputs, transcription and level measurement of source files are perceiving the source; writing an edit list, plan or to-do list is planning; any command that writes the output file, or an intermediate render, is building; any command that reads, measures, transcribes or extracts frames from the agent’s own render is verifying; and a build that follows a verification of the same output is repairing. Commands that match several phases take the latest phase in this order.
blocks.zh: 阶段任务。 我们根据有关工具及其论据的规则,将896项原始行动分配给一个阶段。 阅读摘要、文档或文件列表是定向的;帧提取、接触表、图像读取源帧、输入、抄录和源文件的级别测量正在浏览源;正在计划编写编辑列表、计划或待办事项列表;正在建立编写输出文件或中间渲染物的任何命令;正在核查从代理商自己的渲染物中读取、测量、记录或提取帧的任何命令;正在修复在核查同一输出之后的构建。 匹配多个阶段的指令按此顺序选择最新阶段 。
